[[Andrey Rublev]] defeated [[Félix Auger-Aliassime]] in the final, 4–6, 7–5, 7–5, to win the men's singles tennis title at the [[2024 Mutua Madrid Open|2024 Madrid Open]]. It was his second [[ATP Masters 1000 tournaments|Masters 1000]] title and 16th career [[ATP Tour]] singles title overall.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.theguardian.com/sport/article/2024/may/05/madrid-tennis-final-report-rublev-auger-aliassime|title=Andrey Rublev seals recovery from slump with Madrid Open final triumph|publisher=The Guardian|accessdate=27 April 2025}}</ref>
Auger-Aliassime became the first Canadian singles finalist at the event, and the first to reach a Masters 1000 final on clay.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://mutuamadridopen.com/en/rublev-v-auger-aliassime-final-preview/|title=Rublev v Auger-Aliassime: Final preview|date=4 May 2024}}</ref>

[[Carlos Alcaraz]] was the two-time defending champion,<ref>{{cite web |title=Carlos Alcaraz Defends Madrid Title |url=https://www.atptour.com/en/news/alcaraz-struff-madrid-2023-final-sunday |website=ATP Tour |access-date=18 April 2024 |language=en}}</ref> but lost in the quarterfinals to Rublev.<ref>{{cite web |title=Andrey Rublev defeats Carlos Alcaraz in Madrid |url=https://www.atptour.com/en/news/alcaraz-rublev-madrid-2024-wednesday |website=ATP Tour |access-date=1 May 2024 |language=en}}</ref>

[[Daniil Medvedev]] became the fifth player born in the 1990s (after [[Dominic Thiem]], [[Stefanos Tsitsipas]], [[Alexander Zverev]], and [[Grigor Dimitrov]]) to reach at least the quarterfinals at all nine [[ATP Masters 1000]] events,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Grigor Dimitrov completes career set of Grand Slam quarterfinals at Roland Garros |url=https://www.tennis.com/news/articles/grigor-dimitrov-completes-career-set-of-grand-slam-quarterfinals-at-roland-garros |date=2 June 2024|accessdate=26 December 2024|website=Tennis.com |language=en}}</ref> and the tenth active player overall to accomplish the feat.<ref>{{cite web |title=Daniil Medvedev beats Alexander Bublik in Madrid |url=https://www.atptour.com/en/news/medvedev-bublik-madrid-2024-tuesday |website=ATP Tour |access-date=30 April 2024 |language=en}}</ref> [[Taylor Fritz]] became the first American man to reach the semifinals of the tournament since [[Robby Ginepri]] in [[2005 Mutua Madrileña Masters Madrid – Singles|2005]], and the first to do so since the event switched to [[clay court|clay courts]] in 2009.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.tennis.com/news/articles/taylor-fritz-records-milestone-250th-win-of-career-with-victory-over-cerundolo-in-madrid|title=Taylor Fritz records milestone 250th win of career with victory over Cerundolo in Madrid|date=1 May 2024}}</ref>
